posts.title: The Evolution of CCDC
posts.description: It's been a while (ok too long) since I took the time to talk about CCDC, but after getting back in person for the 2022 National Collegiate Cyber Defense Competition, it seemed timely. This past Thursday, Friday, and Saturday, NCCDC resumed in person competition, returning to its roots in San Antonio.
